note: Functions that left their wrapper before `browser inner` began to keep decisions in their script (tools/restructure/browser-inner-decides.mjs), and hold one: an address, a style from a value that is not written out, an attribute that is not a safe one, innerHTML. They are read without that rule, so the moves that made them can still be redone and checked. Nothing may be added here: a new move is refused instead. A line leaves the list when its function goes back to its script or stops holding the decision. server/test/restructure-browser-inner-decides.test.mjs holds the list to the moves recorded and to this size.
